Package io.github.mikestitt.corbelsflightlog.pedro

Class PedroFlightLog

java.lang.Object
io.github.mikestitt.corbelsflightlog.pedro.PedroFlightLog
public final class PedroFlightLog extends Object
Writes Pedro Pathing's state to a FlightLog, for AdvantageScope.

Two things, either or both:

  • record(Follower) -- the robot's pose, the aim point, the path being followed, the mode and velocities. Call once a loop.
  • record(FollowerLog) -- Pedro's own debug maps, flattened into one channel per entry. Wire with follower.withLogger(pedroLog::record) and Pedro calls it every update.

Everything is written only when it changes (see FlightLog), so a value that holds still costs one record rather than one per loop.

Uses only Pedro's public API. Entries a future Pedro adds to its debug maps appear automatically; a type this doesn't recognise is stored as text.

    • record

      public void record(com.pedropathing.follower.FollowerLog followerLog)
      Pedro's own debug data, one channel per entry, named <prefix>/<map>/<entry>. Wire with follower.withLogger(pedroLog::record).

      Each entry holds whatever Pedro reported on the most recent update, so read them alongside <prefix>/Mode.
